story.intro: BULWARK: "The locker doors. Last stop before the briefing room. Talk to each other, little buddies. Out loud. On the radio."
story.outro: ROOK: "Fine. You can work together." DASH: "Was that a compliment? ROOK, was that a compliment?" ROOK: "No."
